title: Absalom’s Rebellion

questions.question: What did Absalom get for himself to look impressive?
options: A chariot and horses and 50 men to run before him
questions.correctAnswer: A chariot and horses and 50 men to run before him
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 15:1 (ESV): "...Absalom got himself a chariot and horses, and fifty men to run before him."

questions.question: What did Absalom do to the people's hearts?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 15:6 (ESV): "So Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel."

questions.question: Where did Absalom go under the pretense of paying a vow?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 15:7-9 (ESV): "...Please let me go and pay my vow... in Hebron."

questions.question: What signal was given to announce Absalom as king?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 15:10 (ESV): "...As soon as you hear the sound of the trumpet, then say, 'Absalom is king at Hebron!'"

questions.question: What did David do when he heard of the conspiracy?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 15:14 (ESV): "Then David said to all his servants... 'Arise, and let us flee...'"

questions.question: Who was David's counselor that joined Absalom?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 15:12 (ESV): "And while Absalom was offering the sacrifices, he sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David's counselor..."

questions.question: How many concubines did David leave behind to keep the house?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 15:16 (ESV): "But the king left ten concubines to keep the house."

questions.question: Who was the Gittite that vowed to stay with David?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 15:19-21 (ESV): "Then the king said to Ittai the Gittite... But Ittai answered the king... 'wherever my lord the king shall be... there also will your servant be.'"

questions.question: What did David tell Zadok to do with the ark?
options: Carry it back into the city
questions.correctAnswer: Carry it back into the city
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 15:25 (ESV): "Then the king said to Zadok, 'Carry the ark of God back into the city.'"

questions.question: Who did David send back to defeat the counsel of Ahithophel?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 15:32-34 (ESV): "...David said to him... 'if you return to the city... then you may defeat for me the counsel of Ahithophel.'"

questions.question: How did David go up the ascent of the Mount of Olives?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 15:30 (ESV): "But David went up the ascent of the Mount of Olives, weeping as he went, barefoot and with his head covered."

questions.question: What prayer did David pray regarding Ahithophel?
options: Turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness
Let him fall into a pit
questions.correctAnswer: Turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 15:31 (ESV): "...O LORD, please turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness."

questions.question: Where did David wait for news?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 15:28 (ESV): "See, I will wait at the fords of the wilderness until word comes from you to inform me."

questions.question: What were the names of the priests' sons who were to act as messengers?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 15:27 (ESV): "...and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz your son, and Jonathan the son of Abiathar."

questions.question: When did Absalom ask to go to Hebron (after how many years)?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 15:7 (ESV): "And at the end of four years Absalom said to the king..." (Note: Some manuscripts say 40, ESV usually says 4 years).

key_verse_text: Then the king said to Zadok, “Carry the ark of God back into the city. If I find favor in the eyes of the LORD, he will bring me back and let me see both it and his dwelling place. (ESV)
